features.name: l2_norm_from_global_mean
features.description: Euclidean distance of the row from the training-set global mean vector, normalized by the average feature standard deviation. Captures how far a point is from the center of the feature space.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a scale-normalized distance to the global centroid, improving neighborhood geometry by anchoring relative distances.

features.name: zscore_v1
features.description: Z-score normalization of V1 using training-set mean and standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardizes V1 to unit scale, reducing distance distortion caused by differing feature magnitudes in KNN.

features.name: zscore_v2
features.description: Z-score normalization of V2 using training-set mean and standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardizes V2 to unit scale, reducing distance distortion in KNN.

features.name: zscore_v3
features.description: Z-score normalization of V3 using training-set mean and standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardizes V3 to unit scale, reducing distance distortion in KNN.

features.name: zscore_v4
features.description: Z-score normalization of V4 using training-set mean and standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardizes V4 to unit scale, reducing distance distortion in KNN.

features.name: zscore_v5
features.description: Z-score normalization of V5 using training-set mean and standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardizes V5 to unit scale, reducing distance distortion in KNN.

features.name: feature_range_spread
features.description: Difference between the maximum and minimum z-scored feature values within a row, measuring intra-row feature spread.
features.expected_model_benefit: Rows with high spread may occupy different regions of feature space; helps KNN distinguish compact vs. dispersed feature profiles.

features.name: cosine_similarity_to_mean
features.description: Cosine similarity between the row vector and the training-set mean vector, measuring directional alignment with the centroid.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures angular proximity to the centroid, complementing Euclidean distance for KNN neighborhood geometry.

features.name: low_frequency_energy_ratio
features.description: Ratio of squared sum of V1 and V2 (lower-index features) to total squared feature energy, capturing relative energy concentration in early features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes spectral energy distribution pattern; rows with similar ratios cluster together in KNN, improving neighborhood coherence.

features.name: feature_monotonicity_score
features.description: Sum of sign-consistent decrements across consecutive z-scored features, measuring how monotonically decreasing the feature profile is.
features.expected_model_benefit: Rows with similar monotonicity patterns tend to cluster together; helps KNN identify structurally similar feature profiles.

features.name: high_energy_outlier_indicator
features.description: Semantic assessment of whether the row has unusually high total feature energy (L2 norm from origin) compared to typical training samples, scored 0 to 1 where higher means more outlier-like.
features.expected_model_benefit: Identifies high-energy outlier rows that may form sparse neighborhoods in KNN, allowing the model to weight such points differently.

features.name: feature_profile_smoothness
features.description: Semantic assessment of how smoothly the z-scored feature values transition across V1 to V5, scored 0 (highly irregular) to 1 (very smooth/gradual transitions), based on average absolute consecutive difference.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth feature profiles may correspond to distinct phoneme types; helps KNN group rows with similar spectral envelope shapes.
